scope: New root landing experience, bounded interactive SVG study, scroll effects, and migration of the existing gallery to /gallery. No operation, storage, renderer-contract or target-support changes.
historyNote: Successor for the root entry experience and navigation only. Earlier integration, identity and About evidence retain their historical source and image bindings.

design.direction: A playable print-workshop introduction: demonstrate an editable procedure before presenting the collection.
design.preserved: Art with knobs as one natural phrase; exact approved supporting copy; bone/charcoal/oxide identity and procedural mark.
design.motion: Finite headline arrival; CSS ViewTimeline process rule and three print transforms; no requestAnimationFrame loop or scroll listener in application code; static reduced-motion/unsupported-timeline fallback.
design.study: Existing createMarkField and markCommands helper, 32 × 32 marks in a 512-unit SVG viewBox. Field attributes are cached by seed; ink changes reuse geometry. Controls do not write Studio storage.

verification.build: Next production build and TypeScript passed after final navigation fix.
scenarios: Real length, ink and seed edits change rendered pixels; ink preserves geometry; reset exactly restores original pixels and leaves storage untouched.
Native FAQ keyboard disclosure and focus-following section navigation work; scroll timelines visibly change print and process-rule transforms.
Primary action opens hydrated, rendered Studio.
Gallery navigation, search, real study rendering, return-to-gallery and home wordmark work.
Reduced motion removes animations and smooth scrolling without disabling live artwork.
Without JavaScript the original SVG geometry is visible, unavailable controls are disabled with an explanation, and FAQ/gallery links work.
verification.layout: One-line heading and no horizontal overflow at all eight widths; the first range control fits within the tested 844px-tall narrow viewports.
verification.accessibility: axe-core WCAG 2 A/AA and 2.1 AA tags: zero reported violations at 1440, 390 and 320px and with reduced motion. Keyboard range, native FAQ disclosure and section-focus handoff exercised.
verification.motion: Observed intermediate and final ViewTimeline transform matrices, not just animation declarations; reduced motion removes animation and smooth scrolling.

performance.measurement: Input event to next animation-frame callback in local headless Chromium; not a device performance guarantee.

verification.visualReview: Root inspected desktop, narrow, interactive variant and no-JavaScript screenshots. All browser rendering used the shared native-render machine lease.
verification.resolvedDuringReview: Next client navigation did not transfer focus to the process section. A native same-page anchor and programmatically focusable section now pass the actual keyboard/focus scenario.
verification.numerics: Server/client serialized coordinates differed by at most 7.11e-15; exact reset raster hashes matched. No cross-engine bit-identical geometry or cross-layout pixel equivalence is asserted.

limits: Scoped Chromium review, not cross-browser, physical-touch-device, full WCAG or full-corpus certification.
The study is a landing presentation of an existing helper, not a new package operation or technique attestation.
Working-checkout preview only; this review does not claim a main commit or an 8443 deployment.
Existing lib/harness/jobs.ts:58 dynamic filesystem-tracing build warning remains.
